checks.note: The proposition says the market 'has built nearly $1 trillion in infrastructure'. The speaker said it built an infrastructural layer 'with a price tag now leering close to the $1tn mark'. A price tag can include committed spending, and the contract flags built-versus-price-tag as ambiguous. The proposition also drops the claim that the entire market crystallised around a few companies, even beyond the dot-com bubble. The rationale, outcome and citations are otherwise fine, but the e1/e2/e3 excerpts are bare fragments ('$100 billion', 'throughout 2026', '67%').
